note_tweet.text:
It has been a long time since I last did a tarot spread. There have been so many thoughts and emotions in my mind lately that I decided to do a large 19-card spread.

The last card was especially interesting. It was the fourth Wheel of Fortune I have drawn in this relationship. To me, it represents the idea that some things are not entirely within our control. This connection will not remain where it is forever, but it will eventually lead us to where we are meant to be.

Waiting and personal growth have been the main themes of this period.
